interpretation: This is an infrastructure incident, not a Codex-versus-Weave result. Ordinary Codex abstained when it could not inspect evidence. Each Weave run failed its planning-artifact gate and stopped before later phases.
promptExposure: All four task prompts reached the same model and account. The v2 recovery is therefore acceptance evidence on exposed tasks, never unseen-task or benchmark evidence.
